title: ExternalArtifactManifest
description: Contract for artifacts submitted by external agents (Doubao/GPT/Claude/human) to the MathModel harness. The harness validates schema + non-empty + hash binding + provenance before registry admission. LLM-free by design.

executor_type.description: Execution type. Must be 'external_agent' for real agent submissions. 'dry_run' = DefaultNodeExecutor deterministic stub, 'synthetic' = mock executor. Only external_agent may enter capability scoring.

agent_identity.description: Identity of the external agent that produced this artifact.

model_version.description: Model version string. Use 'N/A' when agent_identity is 'human'.

input_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the frozen problem input. Must match the project's frozen input hash; mismatch causes immediate rejection (exit code 2).

node_id.description: DAG node ID that produced this artifact, e.g. 'model_construction', 'experiment_design'.

dag_position.description: DAG position (0-indexed) of the producing node.

prompt_or_skill_version.description: Version of the prompt or SKILL used by the external agent.

artifact_schema_version.description: Version of the artifact schema used for the payload.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the external agent started working on this node.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the external agent finished this node.

latency_seconds.description: Real wall-clock latency in seconds. Must be > 0; below 1s triggers a warning (likely template initialisation).

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this manifest was submitted to the harness.

payload.description: The actual artifact payload. Must be non-empty and pass the artifact-type-specific schema. Content varies by node_id (model spec, experiment plan, result values, etc.).
